clips.title: The story
paras: East of Goldshire, Crystal Lake draws travelers toward a shore claimed by murlocs. Their attacks make the water a danger to villagers and passersby.

Crystal Lake lies east of Goldshire, within walking distance of the Lion's Pride Inn. Freshwater murlocs now claim its shore and shallow shoals, attacking anyone who comes too close. William Pestle, an alchemist at the inn, hires travelers to drive them back and gather the crystal kelp they carry for his experiments.
